reason: I order groceries on Talabat several times a week and never plan ahead, so scanning receipts is a chore I would not keep up. The free version is fine to try, but I would not pay for Plus.
objection: Recipes in these apps are Western, not what we cook. Nothing here says the 400 recipes are Arabic dishes, and I am not scanning receipts to get suggestions for pasta.
would_change_my_mind: Proof that the recipes are mostly Gulf and Levantine dishes we actually cook, plus Ramadan meal planning and an easy way to import my Talabat orders instead of scanning receipts.
